units: <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:7">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>חָשׁ בראשו</he> if one has a head-ache; <he>ח׳ בגרונו</he> one whose throat is affected; a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 5:2:6">Y. Peah V, 18ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>וחש לומר וכ׳</he> but then he reconsidered saying &c.—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:15">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> <he>אל תָּחוּשׁ</he> do not mind it.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:3:3">Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᶜ</cite> top (play on <he>ח̇וש̇ים … ב̇ע̇ר̇א</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 8:8">I Chr. VIII, 8</cite>) <he>ח̇ש̇ כנמר וב̇יא̇ר̇ וכ׳</he> he was quick like a panther and made clear &c.

senses.gloss: to think, be silent, v. חָשָׁה.—V. חָשַׁשׁ.
